subtitle: BBB · CPDL #23617
composer: Michael Praetorius · Text: Martin Luther · Ausgabe: Ross Jallo

source.description: Automatisch umgewandelt aus der MusicXML-Datei „Praetorius_-_Aus_tiefer_Not.mxl“ der CPDL-Seite „Aus tiefer Not schrei ich zu dir a 3 (Michael Praetorius)“ mit tools/liedquellen/cpdl_import.py. Nicht gegen die Vorlage geprüft. Hinweis der Ausgabe: Original key. I don't know where you're going to find a bass with a solid low C, but apparently Praetorius had one. I would recommend the two lower voices be played by cellos or bassoons. Underneath the German I have added Catherine Winkworth's translation into English.
